entries.summary: Wave 1 supports UrlWebViewSource and HtmlWebViewSource on the iframe host but intentionally defers FileWebViewSource, packaged asset loading, and HtmlWebViewSource.BaseUrl-relative resource resolution.
Mirage keeps the MAUI UserAgent mapper surface and deterministic diagnostics projection, but browser iframe hosts do not support a real per-WebView request-header User-Agent override in Wave 1.

Eval and EvaluateJavaScriptAsync execute only for bridge-enabled controlled inline or same-origin probe content inside the sandboxed iframe host. Cross-origin, opaque-origin, or non-bridge content returns deterministic failure/no-op behavior instead of claiming native parity.
Wave 1 does not implement ProcessTerminated, browser cookie synchronization, fullscreen media/process callbacks, or HybridWebView bridging on the iframe host.
